purpose: Separate representation from capacity and test seed stability for compressed shared Adam with PLE
seed_semantics: As in the historical block128 replication: the seed sets initialization and client sampling ({**base, seed}); sample chains must equal historical block128 at each seed
capacity_note: Raw 39 -> 214 -> 32 LayerNorm network has 16,196 parameters versus 16,232 for PLE (213 -> 64 -> 32), following the archived pilot's wider-first-layer capacity control
references: Historical block128 at seeds 7/17/27 from reports/federated_shared_optimizer/block-replication-results.json, same calibration split
replication_rule: compressed_ple must, at EVERY seed versus same-seed block128: gain >= 0.01 macro-F1, absolute FAR difference <= 0.005, largest class recall drop <= 0.05
capacity_rule: Mean compressed_ple macro-F1 across the three seeds must exceed mean compressed_raw_wide by >= 0.01; otherwise attribute the gain to capacity
decision: Keep PLE only if both rules pass; otherwise scrap the extension
limitations: Same historical client partition and previously examined development rows; exploratory only
